t: This is the Royal College of Music in South Kensington. The building was designed by Sir Arthur Blomfield, an English architect who was a keen church builder. He became president of the Architectural Association in 1861 and was later vice-president of the Royal Institute of British Architects. He was also architect to the Bank of England, and he was knighted. In 1891 he received the RIBA gold medal, the profession's highest honour, which tells you the standing of the man who drew up this building.
